$description: System icons — the icons elements draw themselves, as mask images: an element paints its own color through the icon's shape, so only the alpha counts. Override one on `:root` with any square, single-color `url()` to re-skin it in every element at once. Content icons the page author picks stay `<l-icon>`.

chevron-down.$description: Downward chevron. Drawn by the caret of `.l-select`, l-select and l-combobox, the `arrow` marker of l-disclosure, and an expanded l-tree-item.

chevron-right.$description: Inline-end chevron, mirrored in right-to-left layouts. Drawn by the submenu indicator of l-dropdown-item and a collapsed l-tree-item.
